item.title: Middle East war live: Trump says US may hit Iran again, claims Tehran wants deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that the United States may need to attack Iran again and claimed that he had been only an hour away from deciding ‌on a fresh strike before he allegedly postponed the attack. Thousands of people have been killed in Iran, Lebanon and the wider Middle East since the US-Israeli war against Iran began at the end of February. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

item.title: Early War Goal Was to Install Hard Line Former President as Iran’s Leader
item.description: An Israeli strike designed to free Mahmoud Ahmadinejad from house arrest in Tehran, U.S. officials said, was part of an effort to bring about regime change and put him in power.

item.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza have stepped up since halt in bombing in Iran
item.description: At least five Palestinians were killed in Israeli strikes on the Gaza Strip on May 17. Israel has stepped up attacks in Gaza in the weeks since halting its ​joint bombing ‌with the US in Iran. Netanyahu's government says Hamas fighters are tightening their grip on the strip. The devastated Palestinian territory has seen near-daily Israeli fire since the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas went into effect in October.

item.title: U.S. government to drop tax claims against Trump in broadening of IRS settlement
item.description: As part of the settlement agreement, the U.S. is "forever barred and precluded" from examining or prosecuting President Trump, his sons and the Trump organization's current tax issues, according to a document posted to the DOJ website.

item.title: Endorsed by Trump, Ed Gallrein defeats Rep. Thomas Massie in GOP House primary
item.description: In a major victory for President Trump, his hand-picked challenger, Ed Gallrein, beat out U.S. House Rep. Thomas Massie in a Kentucky House GOP primary, ending Massie's reelection bid.

item.title: Admiral accuses lawmaker of ‘inappropriate’ remark at Iran war hearing
item.description: Adm. Brad Cooper, the head of U.S. Central Command, appeared frustrated with questions from House Democrats who pressed him on a range of issues about the conflict.

item.title: Israel's trying to expel a whole Palestinian district in East Jerusalem, activists say
item.description: Israeli authorities are issuing Palestinians demolition orders in East Jerusalem at an accelerated rate since Israel launched war with Iran, human rights groups and U.N. experts say.

item.title: Lettuce introduce you to the live frog found in this grocery store salad bag
item.description: An Australian farmer has found a live frog in a bag of lettuce

item.title: Libyan detention facility head known as 'Angel of Death' faces Int'l Criminal Court
item.description: Prosecutors at the International Criminal Court have told judges that the senior commander of a Libyan detention facility murdered and raped prisoners, sometimes in front of their children

item.title: Middle East war live: Trump to attend G7 summit in France in June
item.description: US President Donald Trump will travel to next month's G7summit in France, a White House official told AFP Tuesday, despite tensions between Washington and its allies on a host of issues from Iran to tariffs. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
